lyrics.ja: ゆっくりと歩く道 どこまでも続く空
lyrics.romaji: Yukkuri to aruku michi doko made mo tsuzuku sora
lyrics.en: A path walked slowly, the sky stretching endlessly
lyrics.zh: 緩緩前行的道路 天空無限延伸

lyrics.ja: 振り返れば遠い日々 夢の欠片を探して
lyrics.romaji: Furikaereba tooi hibi yume no kakera wo sagashite
lyrics.en: Looking back at distant days, searching for fragments of dreams
lyrics.zh: 回首遙遠的歲月 尋找夢的碎片

lyrics.ja: 立ち止まることもあったけど
lyrics.en: There were times I stopped, but
This feeling I've always believed in

lyrics.ja: ゆっくり走れば風は吹く 新しい明日へ
lyrics.romaji: Yukkuri hashireba kaze wa fuku atarashii asu e
lyrics.en: If you run slowly, the wind will blow, towards a new tomorrow
lyrics.zh: 緩緩奔跑風會吹拂 邁向嶄新的明天

lyrics.ja: どんな時もそばにいるよ ずっとこのままで
lyrics.romaji: Donna toki mo soba ni iru yo zutto kono mama de
lyrics.en: I'll always be by your side, forever just like this
lyrics.zh: 無論何時都會在你身旁 永遠如此

lyrics.ja: 小さな光集めて 輝く星になろう
lyrics.romaji: Chiisana hikari atsumete kagayaku hoshi ni narou
lyrics.en: Gathering small lights, let's become a shining star
lyrics.zh: 匯聚微小的光芒 成為閃耀的星辰

lyrics.ja: 迷いながらも進む道 希望の歌を歌おう
lyrics.romaji: Mayoi nagara mo susumu michi kibou no uta wo utaou
lyrics.en: Even while lost, we advance, let's sing a song of hope
lyrics.zh: 即使迷惘也要前行 歌唱希望之歌

lyrics.ja: 涙の数だけ強くなれる
lyrics.romaji: Namida no kazu dake tsuyoku nareru
lyrics.en: The more tears, the stronger we become
lyrics.zh: 流多少淚就能變得多堅強

lyrics.ja: 笑顔見せて歩き出そう
lyrics.en: Show a smile and let's start walking

lyrics.ja: ゆっくり走れば風は吹く 新しい明日へ

lyrics.zh: 無論何時都會在你身旁 永遠如此

lyrics.ja: 広い世界で出会えた奇跡
lyrics.en: A miracle we met in this wide world
lyrics.zh: 在廣闊世界中相遇的奇蹟

lyrics.romaji: Taisetsu na kizuna wo mune ni
lyrics.en: With precious bonds in our hearts
lyrics.zh: 將珍貴的羈絆銘記於心
